'''David Brimmer''' is an American voice actor and fight choreographer who currently works for the English [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is sometimes credited as '''Michael Alston Bailey''', '''Michael Alston Baley''', '''David J. Brimmer''', or '''J. David Brimmer'''.

== Biography ==
Brimmer began portraying characters on the series during [[S01|the first season]]. After [[S04|the 4th season]], he ended his tenure with the series, but continued to work with 4Kids Entertainment, presumably until before their bankruptcy. Brimmer returned to the series in ''[[DP082|Cream of the Croagunk Crop!]]'', voicing [[Crasher Wake]].
